message: docs(automation): align targeted evidence and independent CI contracts

edits.find: `expected_blobs` names every distinct edited path exactly once, using its original Git blob SHA or `null` for an absent file.
edits.replace: `expected_blobs` names every distinct edited or validated path exactly once, using its original Git blob SHA. Only apply and preview may use `null` for an absent file; validation requires existing files.

edits.find: Candidate JSON is bounded to 1,800,000 bytes, each candidate text file to 1,500,000 bytes, and the artifact download to 2,000,000 bytes.
edits.replace: Combined original target text is bounded to 1,500,000 bytes. Candidate JSON is bounded to 1,800,000 bytes, each candidate text file to 1,500,000 bytes, and the artifact download to 2,000,000 bytes.

edits.find: Paths outside core source and deleted preview files are explicitly not applicable, never called passed.
edits.replace: Paths outside core source and deleted non-document preview files are explicitly not applicable, never called passed. A changed or deleted sister document also checks its surviving source partner, so a document-only edit cannot hide a broken mirror.

edits.find: - Seven checks gate a merge: `quality`, `integration`, `boundaries`, `read-budget`, `build`, `end-to-end`, and the advisory `performance`. Squash merge once they are green. `read-budget` runs `npm run test:read-budget`, and it is in `CI` because the implementor the budget protects cannot run it and cannot see a truncated read.
edits.replace: - CI preserves seven contexts: `quality`, `integration`, `boundaries`, `read-budget`, `build`, `end-to-end`, and `performance`. The benchmark's failures are not advisory exemptions. Verify repository-required checks before merging; their names alone do not prove branch-protection settings. `read-budget` runs the actual scanner, while its unit tests run in the single full suite. [CI-WORKFLOW.md](./CI-WORKFLOW.md) owns current evidence requirements.

edits.find: - A failed or timed-out `CI` or `Recovery audit` run archives to the `ci-logs` branch at `logs/<run-id>/`, with `README.md`, `run.json` and `failed-jobs.log`. Cite the Actions URL as primary and read the archive for durable failing-first evidence. `archive-ci-logs.yml` is deliberately not branch-filtered, so a `feat/**` head ref needs nothing dispatched by hand; manual `workflow_dispatch` with a `run_id` stays available for a run the `if:` gate skipped.
edits.replace: - Activated trusted reporting retains CI outcomes and bounded diagnostics under `ci-logs/receipts/<kind>/<run-id>/<attempt>/`. Older runs may use `logs/<run-id>/`; inspect the deployed reporter rather than assuming an archive format. Cite the Actions run as primary and readable retained evidence for failing-first assertions. Reporter activation and manual recovery require the reviewed pin and exact run/attempt inputs, not a green implementation PR.

edits.find: A test file naming a member that does not exist yet fails `typecheck` and stops `quality` before `npm test`.
edits.replace: A test file naming a member that does not exist yet fails `typecheck`; independent suite execution does not make that a valid typechecking result.

edits.find: A run that failed `typecheck` or `format:check` ran no test at all, so it is a broken file rather than evidence.
edits.replace: A failed `typecheck` or `format:check` is not assertion-level failing-first evidence. When independent suite execution still ran, cite its actual assertion result rather than attributing another gate's failure to the test.
